body:
Fix sidecar manifest configurations to remove developer-specific absolute paths (/Users/voodootikigod/...) and brittle relative traversals (../../../). Use runtime module resolution or environment macros in jetski-launcher.mjs.

Acceptance criteria:
1. sidecar.json files contain no hardcoded absolute developer paths.
2. Relative entrypoint paths resolve properly when sidecars are launched from any working directory.
3. npm test passes cleanly.
title: fix: resolve fragile relative and hardcoded absolute paths in sidecar manifests
